title: Microsoft Purview Compliance Portal: Enhancements to variant limits and detection groups
description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management variant limit is being increased from 3 to 10 per indicator and an overall limit of 100 across all indicators. Along with this, the number of items in one detection group is being increased from 200 to 500.
